brand_notes: Hsu Research: factory-direct US maker (best known for subwoofers) selling CCB-8 ($389 ea) and MFL-6 ($279 ea) as current speakers; HB-1 MK2 no longer on store. Designs use Don Keele constant-directivity horns, but ASR Klippel results (asr-hsu-research-ccb-8, asr-hsu-research-mfl-6) show rough response and non-constant directivity; both measure about 4 ohm minimum. Maker spec sensitivity is quoted in half-space (+6 dB vs full-space). Maker store shows 7-year warranty claim (per Widescreen Review quote) and 30-day return.
takeaways: Very efficient (88.8 dB) coaxial horn speaker with good bass reach (f3 59 Hz) for the price
Messy on-axis response: LW ±5.2 dB, deep 1.7 kHz notch, ER dip 4.8 dB; ASR does not recommend
Impedance min 3.8 Ω (ASR) so effectively 4 Ω despite 8 Ω setting; Audioholics measured 5 Ω
Audioholics and AV Nirvana liked detail and imaging; recommend listening 15-25 degrees off axis
Distortion clean at 86 dB, rises sharply at 96 dB; audible at 101 dB (ASR)
conflicts: Nominal impedance 8 Ω setting (maker page) vs 6 Ω (Audioholics says Hsu quotes)
Audioholics ±3 dB gated on-axis vs ASR ±5.2 dB LW with 1.7 kHz notch
